# duploai_s3_bucket (Data Source)

Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS S3 bucket.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an S3 bucket by ID.
data "duploai_s3_bucket" "example" {
  workspace_id = "<workspace-id>"
  id           = "<object-id>"
}

output "bucket_arn" {
  value = data.duploai_s3_bucket.example.bucket_arn
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the object to look up.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace that owns this S3 bucket.

### Read-Only

- `block_public_access` (Attributes) S3 Block Public Access settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--block_public_access))
- `bucket_arn` (String) ARN of the provisioned bucket.
- `bucket_domain_name` (String) Domain name of the provisioned bucket.
- `bucket_policy` (String) Inline bucket policy as a JSON string.
- `cors_rules` (Attributes List) CORS rules for the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cors_rules))
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `enable_object_lock` (Boolean) Enable S3 Object Lock (can only be set at bucket creation).
- `enable_versioning` (Boolean) Enable object versioning on the bucket.
- `encryption_type` (String) Server-side encryption: Sse (S3-managed), SseKmsAwsManaged (AWS-managed KMS), or SseResourceGroupKms (resource-group KMS key).
- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment that owns the resource group.
- `kms_key_id` (String) KMS key ID used when encryption_type is a KMS mode.
- `name` (String) Name of the S3 bucket.
- `object_ownership` (String) Object ownership / ACL behavior.
- `policies` (List of String) Names of managed policies to attach to the bucket.
- `provisioner_type` (String) Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.
- `provisioner_version` (String) Optional provisioner version.
- `region` (String) AWS region the bucket is created in (e.g. us-west-2).
- `resource_group_id` (String) ID of the resource group this bucket belongs to.
- `s3_bucket_id` (String) UUID of this S3 bucket, for reference by dependent resources.
- `scope_ids` (List of String) Scope IDs that link this bucket to a cloud provider account.
- `status` (String) Current provisioning status.
- `user_tags` (Map of String) User-defined tags applied to the bucket.

<a id="nestedatt--block_public_access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `block_public_access`

Read-Only:

- `block_public_acls` (Boolean) Block new public ACLs.
- `block_public_policy` (Boolean) Block public bucket policies.
- `ignore_public_acls` (Boolean) Ignore existing public ACLs.
- `restrict_public_buckets` (Boolean) Restrict access to buckets with public policies.


<a id="nestedatt--cors_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cors_rules`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_headers` (List of String) Allowed request headers.
- `allowed_methods` (List of String) Allowed HTTP methods (e.g. GET, PUT).
- `allowed_origins` (List of String) Allowed origins.
- `expose_headers` (List of String) Response headers exposed to the browser.
- `max_age_seconds` (Number) Preflight cache duration in seconds.
